items: Pain that wakes you at night

caption:
Mr Turtle sat bolt upright all day and ended up more tired, not less. Research suggests there's no strong link between how people sit or stand and whether they get back or neck pain. Plenty of people with 'bad' posture have none, and the reverse is true too.

What usually bothers us is staying in one position for hours, even a textbook one. Slouching on the couch is fine. If it starts to ache, take that as a nudge to move.

Hybi's habit: a gentle reminder every 30 minutes to shift, stand or stretch, mixing sitting, standing and walking through the day, plus regular walks and a couple of strength sessions a week. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐢
